title: Automate bounded parity checks and prepare original e2e test reuse

acceptance_criteria.description: One-command real proxy comparison and additive upstream e2e binary selection preserve original assertions and Haskell defaults.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual proxy capture/comparison; staged selection tests; required upstream test catalogue and incomplete-report negatives; honest missing e2e environment.

acceptance_criteria.description: Harness boundaries, retained comparisons and migration state/scope pass; efficient risk-based stopping rules recorded.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Harness/foundation/retained-oracle unit checks and CI wiring; migration tests/scope/diff; unchanged Haskell sources.

evidence.command: One-command proxy API execution: actual pinned Haskell and identified Go candidate, 103 pass/0 fail. Eight harness boundaries validate unchanged-original e2e staging, required catalogue and fail-closed reports. Missing full e2e environment reported explicitly, not as a pass.

36 parity/harness tests, 15 oracle tests, 32 migration tests, workflow YAML/embedded Python parsing, scoped migration and whitespace checks. Metadata-only change selection tested; Haskell sources/build inputs/default charts unchanged.

handoff: Bounded automation/preparation complete: one-command proxy runtime comparison passed, original e2e binary-selection adapter and fail-closed required-test catalogue tested, local CI wiring and risk-based stop rules in place. Proxy automation is validated; original e2e adapter is not runtime-qualified because compiled Haskell bundle and disposable backend dependencies are absent. Provision that environment and run Haskell baseline before cargohold; no user manual testing required. No service promotion, production change, original-suite success or remote-CI success claimed.
